description: As a platform engineer, you need to verify the configuration of a CI/CD pipeline tool that uses an INI-style configuration file. The file is located at /home/user/ci_cd/config.ini. Your task is to: 1. Parse the config.ini file to extract all key-value pairs from the section labeled [deployment]. 2. Output these key-value pairs (without comments or section headers) in the format key=value, one per line, in the order they appear in the file. 3. Save this output to a new file at /home/user/ci_cd/deployment_config.log. The automated test will check that: - The deployment_config.log file contains only the key-value pairs from the [deployment] section, with no extra whitespace or blank lines. - The values should appear in the same order as in config.ini. Do not modify config.ini. Only create or modify deployment_config.log.
truth:
Before the agent starts, the file /home/user/ci_cd/config.ini exists with the following contents: 
[general]
env=staging
build_number=615

[deployment]
strategy=blue-green
timeout=300
rollback=true

[notifications]
slack_channel=devops-alerts
After the agent completes the task, the file /home/user/ci_cd/deployment_config.log will exist with the following precise contents: 
strategy=blue-green
timeout=300
rollback=true
The format is exactly as above: one key=value pair per line, no extra spacing or lines, and in the order present in the original config.ini.
